titulo: HP’s HyperX Omen 15 isn’t quite the budget-friendly gaming laptop its predecessor was
cuerpo: The HP HyperX Omen 15, which I first saw at CES, replaces the HP Victus 15, a longtime bestselling budget gaming laptop.
